newsitem.title: USA: Digi sees Q1 net below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Digi sees Q1 net below estimates.

text.p: Digi International Inc said Monday it expects earnings for the first quarter ending December 31 to be below analysts' estimates, which it said range from $0.23-$0.27 a share.
The expected shortfall is due to anticipated shortfalls in original equipment manufacturer revenue, and delays in new product rollouts, the company said.
Earlier Monday Digi reported restated earnings for the year ago quarter of $4.5 million, or $0.33 a share.
Shares in the data communications hardware and software maker were unchanged at 12-3/4 Monday.
